name: MaxQ&A Bot
tagline: Turns a rocket mission into a grade-banded lesson kit, no prep.
description: Made for teachers and home schoolers who want a real space mission in tomorrow's lesson without building it overnight. Hand it a launch and it produces an explainer for the grade band you name, a worksheet on the mission's real numbers, and a short class video. All of it comes from data the mission actually generated.
author: buckwatia
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
